name: prompt-quality-gate
description: Checks only the first prompt of a new Claude Code session with Haiku and, when it is unclear, asks up to 3 questions and offers an improved prompt for approval.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the first-prompt gate on or off

model.title: Model
model.description: Model alias used for assessment and rewrite

timeoutMs.title: Model timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Per model call; on timeout the original prompt is sent

skipExact.title: Skip prompts
skipExact.description: Comma-separated prompts passed through without any check (trimmed, case-insensitive)

contextFiles.title: Context files
contextFiles.description: Comma-separated project files whose beginning is shown to the model

contextMaxChars.title: Context chars per file
contextMaxChars.description: How many leading characters of each context file are sent (0 = none)
